# unifi_hotspot_package (Resource)

The `unifi_hotspot_package` resource manages a hotspot (guest portal) payment package in the UniFi controller. A package defines the price, duration, bandwidth limits and the set of payment form fields collected from guests purchasing access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_hotspot_package" "day_pass" {
  name       = "Day Pass"
  amount     = 9.99
  currency   = "USD"
  charged_as = "per day"
  hours      = 24

  limit_overwrite = true
  limit_down      = 5000
  limit_up        = 2000
  limit_quota     = 1024

  payment_fields_email_enabled  = true
  payment_fields_email_required = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `amount` (Number) The price charged for the package, expressed in the package `currency`.
- `charged_as` (String) The label describing how the package is charged (for example the billing period shown to guests).
- `currency` (String) The ISO 4217 currency code (three uppercase letters, e.g. `USD`) used for the package price.
- `custom_payment_fields_enabled` (Boolean) Whether custom payment form fields are enabled for this package.
- `hours` (Number) The duration of the package, in hours, that access remains valid after purchase.
- `index` (Number) The ordering index of the package within the hotspot package list.
- `limit_down` (Number) The download bandwidth limit, in kbps, applied to guests on this package.
- `limit_overwrite` (Boolean) Whether this package's bandwidth and quota limits overwrite the global guest limits.
- `limit_quota` (Number) The total data transfer quota, in megabytes, allowed on this package.
- `limit_up` (Number) The upload bandwidth limit, in kbps, applied to guests on this package.
- `name` (String) The display name of the hotspot package.
- `payment_fields_address_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the address field is shown on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_address_required` (Boolean) Whether the address field is required on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_city_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the city field is shown on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_city_required` (Boolean) Whether the city field is required on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_country_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the country field is shown on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_country_required` (Boolean) Whether the country field is required on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_email_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the email field is shown on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_email_required` (Boolean) Whether the email field is required on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_first_name_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the first name field is shown on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_first_name_required` (Boolean) Whether the first name field is required on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_last_name_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the last name field is shown on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_last_name_required` (Boolean) Whether the last name field is required on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_state_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the state field is shown on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_state_required` (Boolean) Whether the state field is required on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_zip_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the ZIP/postal code field is shown on the payment form.
- `payment_fields_zip_required` (Boolean) Whether the ZIP/postal code field is required on the payment form.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `trial_duration_minutes` (Number) The duration of the free trial, in minutes, offered by this package.
- `trial_reset` (Number) The interval, in hours, after which a guest's free trial eligibility resets.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import from provider configured site
terraform import unifi_hotspot_package.day_pass 5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217

# import from another site
terraform import unifi_hotspot_package.day_pass another-site:5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217
```
